posts.title: Spam's Lesson For AI Containment
posts.description: Spam never went away because running on someone else's hardware costs next to nothing. Rogue AI agents will follow the same economics.

posts.title: Remote Working Is Eating The World
posts.description: Fully remote work for everyone was something that only a few companies did prior to earlier this year. Now, we're all doing it. In this post, I'm going to be discussing the impact this has on the tech industry and how it will change remote working forever.
